label: Seasonal & Current Collection Policy
rationale: The current catalog has strong category evidence for snow, water, cities and wildlife but insufficient explicit season metadata for truthful autumn/spring/holiday collections.
Watch Earth already owns current moment logic such as daylight, night cities, golden light and local-time-aware selection.
Duplicating current-moment logic in crawlable collection pages would create stale or conflicting claims.
futureSeasonalTrigger: Open a seasonal collection only when explicit source metadata/evidence can support it without inference.
